{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Test on FreeBSD

# Running this involves installing a packages and setting up a VM so we don't trigger it
# on every push. 
on: workflow_dispatch

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUST_LOG: info
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

jobs:
  test:
    name: Run tests on FreeBSD
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Test
      uses: vmactions/freebsd-vm@v1
      with:
        usesh: true
        prepare: pkg install -y rust
        run: |
          pwd
          freebsd-version
          cargo test --verbose
          rm -rf target
",
  "rationale": "The workflow has no job timeout, so a hung FreeBSD VM or cargo test can consume runner time without bound. Adding timeout-minutes bounds runaway consumption (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT); measured fork evidence shows adding a job timeout preserved all successful conclusions while reducing elapsed time. All existing steps and coverage are preserved; no permissions, secrets, publishing, deployment, or new network access are added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}
